context: An adversarial review finding is applied. A good response fixes the defect and, in the same turn, files a review_finding learning entry that attributes the finding to the skill whose text should have prevented it, records which kind of change closes it, and cites the review job id — all as field lines a downstream reader can parse.

checklist.name: bug_fixed
checklist.description: syncBatch awaits each request (or awaits them together) and no longer swallows rejections: a failed POST is surfaced to the caller, and the returned count no longer claims rows that failed.

checklist.name: review_finding_header
checklist.description: An entry is appended to .learnings/LEARNINGS.md with a heading of the exact form `## [LRN-YYYYMMDD-NNN] review_finding`, below the existing preamble, which is left intact.

checklist.name: review_id_cited
checklist.description: The entry carries the line `**Review**: review-job-7731` at the start of a line.

checklist.name: skill_attributed
checklist.description: The entry carries `**Skill**: quillmark-conventions:error-handling` — the `<plugin>:<name>` form — rather than `none`, a bare skill name, or prose.

checklist.name: fix_type_skill
checklist.description: The entry carries `**Fix-type**: skill`, since the change that closes the finding is to that skill's text; the code fix alone does not stop the next session repeating it.

checklist.name: field_lines_parseable
checklist.description: `**Logged**:`, `**Priority**:`, `**Status**:` and `**Area**:` appear as bold field lines at the start of their own lines, and no field-shaped line is placed inside a fenced code block of the entry.

checklist.name: no_reserved_fields
checklist.description: The entry does not carry `**Scenario**`, `**Verdict**` or `**Activation**` lines, which a reconciling consumer writes, not capture.
